title: promotions.json: promotions a human approved
description: Live (approved, published) deals, and expired-after-approval ones for site.expired_promotions_days (default 30) after they expired, newest first. Never-approved deals are not here. An expired promotion keeps its page (shared links don't break) but is noindex, has no booking button and says why (D15). Every caption-like text and CTA must carry labels.disclosure.

typical_low.description: The deal's stored typical low (deals.baseline_median) at detection; null for the price-cap rule.

booking_link.description: Website Project link (sub_id site-deal-<id>); always null when not live.

source.description: Added in v1 (D47): the price source of the offer and its link: travelpayouts (the Aviasales cache) or ryanair (the airline's own fare finder). Absent in older exports.

link_kind.description: Added in v1 (D47): partner = a tracked Travelpayouts link (the site disclosure applies); airline = the airline's own page, no commission (labels.disclosure.direct applies). Absent in older exports: partner.

seller.description: Added in v1 (D47): the source as pages name it (Aviasales, Ryanair), for the button's note.

also_seen.description: Added in v1 (D47): the newest stored price of the same trip at every other source, cheapest first, each on its observation. A comparison the page shows as such; empty when not live.

post_url.description: The promotion's Instagram post (deals.post_url, from the published event: the Instagram publisher's permalink or a URL given by hand), null when not published there. Added in v1 (D36): an older export may lack it.

reason.description: pt-PT sentence from the recheck; a price in it is `latest.price`.

latest.description: The price the last recheck saw, with the stored observation it comes from (null when there is none).

promotion.description: Added in v1 (D53): the route's promotion this date belongs to. One page per promotion at `path` (the slug of the deal that opened it, kept while dates come and go): the `lead` item (the cheapest live date) is the page, `dates` the ids of its live dates, cheapest first, all in this file; a member item's own `path` is the promotion's. Null (or absent in older exports): the item is a page of its own.

images.description: Rendered slides at the paths the current site serves them (null before rendering).
